name: Clicklastica
author: DigiDepot

sections.description:
Clicklastica is a lightweight WordPress plugin that runs silently in the background and blocks multiple browser actions that are commonly used to copy or steal website content.

There is no settings page — just install and activate. The protection works instantly.

The plugin only runs on the frontend and does not affect administrators or logged-in users.

Features

  • Disable right-click context menu
  • Block F12 and developer tools
  • Disable keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+U, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+X)
  • Block drag and drop
  • Disable text selection
  • Silent mode: no popup, no warning message
  • No settings or configuration needed
  • Admin-safe and frontend-only
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress site.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins screen.
  3. You’re done! All features are now active on the frontend.
sections.faq:
Why can I still right-click or select text?

If you’re logged in as an admin, Clicklastica does not block you. Log out or test in an incognito window.

Is there a settings page?

No. Clicklastica has no settings. All features are enabled by default for simplicity and performance.

Can users still bypass this?

Clicklastica blocks casual copying, but advanced users can still find ways using tools or code. No plugin can offer 100% protection.
